mapper.select: select sd.D_Name as stDName, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from OA_Supervision_Task mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Department sd on mn.St_D_Id=sd.D_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.St_Id where mn.St_Id=#{stId}
